Obiettivo, livello, programma, attrezzatura e spazio — poca scrittura, tanta scelta visiva.
Il pianificatore esclude gli esercizi per cui mancano attrezzatura, spazio o tempo e crea un piano di 4 settimane.
Immagini degli esercizi, timer di recupero, serie spuntate e valutazione dello sforzo — gli allenamenti successivi si adattano con prudenza.

TrainUp builds workout plans around your goal, equipment and space. To do that we need some of your data. This page explains in plain language which data, and why.
1. Who is responsible for your data
The operator of TrainUp (“we”) decides how and why your data is processed and is responsible for protecting it.
We process only what the app needs to work:
Account: name, email and profile photo from your Google or Apple account.
Profile: goal, fitness level, training schedule, language and time zone; optionally age, height and weight.
Equipment and space: what you train with, the size of your space, surface, ceiling height, noise and jumping restrictions.
Limitations and pain: body areas to protect, notes about them, and pain you report during workouts.
Plans and workouts: generated plans, completed sets, duration, effort rating (RPE) and your notes.
To-dos and reminders: your daily tasks and workout reminder settings.

Information about limitations, pain, weight and how you feel can count as health data, which is a special category. You provide it voluntarily and can skip most of it. We use it only to choose safer exercises, and only with your consent, which you give by filling in the relevant fields. You can withdraw consent at any time by deleting this data or your whole account.
We do not sell your data, we do not show ads, and we do not currently use advertising or analytics trackers.
Providing the service (performance of a contract): account, plan generation, workout tracking, to-dos and reminders.
Your consent: processing of health data and limitations.
Legitimate interest: account security and abuse prevention.
5. Where data is stored and who processes it

Sign-in and data storage are provided by Google Firebase (Authentication and Firestore). The database is located in the European Union (Frankfurt, Germany). Sign-in with Google or Apple is handled by those companies under their own privacy policies. Each user’s data is isolated: access rules do not allow other users to read it.
Your browser also stores technical data on your device: your sign-in session, language, theme and drafts (for example an unfinished workout).

TrainUp works without AI. If we add optional AI features, only the minimum data needed to build a plan will be sent to third-party providers — never your name, email or free-text notes — and only if you turned the feature on.
We keep your data while you have an account. You can delete your account and all related data in the app: Profile → Data and privacy. Deletion is permanent.

Your data stays under your control
We store only what the plan needs, never sell data and show no ads. Data is kept in the EU, and you can download it or delete your account at any time.
Do I need AI to get a plan?
No. A planner builds your plan from clear rules — no prompts or chats. AI is only an optional extra, and even then the same validator checks every proposal.
Will TrainUp work if I have little space or no equipment?
Yes. You tell it what you have and how much room there is, and the planner picks only exercises that can be done in your space.
What happens if I feel pain during a workout?
Tap “I feel pain”: the exercise stops, is paused, and will not be suggested again until you bring it back. The app never increases load because of pain.
Does TrainUp replace a coach or a doctor?
No. TrainUp does not diagnose or treat anything. If you have a medical condition or an injury, talk to a doctor before you start training.
What data do you store, and can I delete it?
Only what the plan needs: your profile, equipment, space, limitations and workout history. Data is stored in the EU, and you can download it or delete your account at any time.

Choose your goal, level, schedule, equipment and free space. TrainUp builds an achievable programme and adapts later sessions to how you feel.
